samples.question: The six colored squares form a cube net: the junction square starts FRONT, the square above it starts TOP, and the squares left, right, below, and far-right start LEFT, RIGHT, BOTTOM, and BACK. Read the six arrows in the attached rail from top to bottom. Each arrow rolls the cube one quarter-turn in that screen direction: up brings the current FRONT face to TOP, down brings BACK to TOP, left brings RIGHT to TOP, and right brings LEFT to TOP. Colors stay attached to their faces. After all six rolls, which color is on TOP?
